# Compatibility redirect

This old skill name is retained so existing prompts do not select the former
unbounded interview. Load and follow `../grill-task-gu/SKILL.md` completely.

The inherited contract is authoritative:

```text
full relevant discovery → exactly one Decision Sheet → backlog + coverage → handoff
```

Never ask one question per turn, never reopen a locked decision at a phase gate,
and never ask for assignment or dates unless the invocation includes `--schedule`.
